name: Podcasts
description: Manage podcast subscriptions with automatic RSS feed updates, episode downloads, auto-delete after listening, and daily auto-playlist generation.
overview: Subscribe to podcast RSS feeds, automatically download new episodes, manage auto-deletion of listened content, and generate a daily auto-playlist of unlistened episodes.
changelog:
- FIXED: 'Escanear biblioteca de podcasts' task now scans ONLY the podcast folder (the 'Podcasts' subfolder inside the music library) instead of the entire Jellyfin library
- NEW: Uses ILibraryManager.FindByPath + Folder.ValidateChildren for a targeted recursive scan of just the podcast folder
- NEW: Smart fallback — if the 'Podcasts' folder is not yet indexed by Jellyfin, scans only the parent music library to discover it (not the whole server)
- NEW: Last-resort fallback to full library scan only if neither the podcast folder nor the music library can be located
- Faster scan, does not touch movies/TV/other music libraries
